stories.title: Amnesty, IPSC rally support for Palestine at Ireland’s Electric Picnic
stories.summary: Amnesty, IPSC rally support for Palestine at Ireland’s Electric Picnic Ireland’s Electric Picnic festival became a platform for Palestinian solidarity, with rights organisations and attendees backing campaigns against Israel’s Gaza genocide. A walk organised by the Ireland-Palestine Solidarity Campaign (IPSC) during Ireland’s popular Electric Picnic music festival received “massive solidarity” from the onlookers, IPSC said in a post on X. Global Green went for a walk through the Electric Picnic Arena today! stories.title: Can an accused be denied a copy of the FIR? | Explained
stories.summary: Experts told The Hindu that police officials routinely fail to comply with the Supreme Court’s directive to upload FIRs online within 24 hours of registration. What do statutory provisions stipulate? What are the implications?
